story.sq05.title: Borrowed Iron
story.sq05.summary: Trace a missing brace through the stonewright’s records and decide where one reusable fitting is most useful.
story.sq05.s1.objective: Inspect Qiao’s returned tool crate and the unclosed loan entry.
story.sq05.s1.journal: The crate is short one iron brace, but the loan entry says it was left supporting the village wheel. The word “missing” hides whether something is lost, borrowed, or still doing work.
story.sq05.s1.lan: I was ready to call Qiao careless. Then I found this note under the lid. The crate came back; its last brace did not. That may have been deliberate.
story.sq05.s1.apprentice: We should look at what it is holding before we demand it back.
story.sq05.s1.note: Qiao’s loan note, two seasons earlier: “One brace remains at the grain wheel. The old socket has split; removing it before the stone wedge is seated risks the axle. I owe the sanctuary the fitting, not an apology for keeping the wheel standing. Please inspect first. My return receipt is in the same crate.”
story.sq05.s2.objective: Seat the existing stone wedge, then choose a use for the freed brace.
story.sq05.s2.journal: The wedge can safely take the old brace’s load. Afterward the brace can reinforce the grain-wheel housing or replace a rusting plaque stand at the public inspection board. Both are practical repairs, not a choice between feeding people and respecting the dead.
story.sq05.s2.lan: The axle has its new wedge. The spare can quiet that loose housing, or stop the board plate falling on someone’s foot. Tell Qiao where it goes, so the next loan record is true.
story.sq05.s2.clue: A load arrow is cut into the wedge. Slide it beneath the marked axle seat until the hanging plumb line aligns; only then release the brace latch. The brace is a world prop, not a loot item, and cannot be sold or removed while loaded.
story.sq05.s2.choice_a: Reinforce the wheel housing; record the new placement.
story.sq05.s2.choice_b: Repair the public board’s plaque stand; record the new placement.
story.sq05.s2.reply_a: The housing is quiet now. The plaque can rest flat until a new stand is made; its inscription will remain readable.
story.sq05.s2.reply_b: The board plate is secure now. The wheel is safe on its stone wedge; its housing repair can wait for the next iron delivery.
story.sq05.s3.objective: Close the loan with the brace’s current location and inspect Qiao’s balance sketch.
story.sq05.s3.journal: Qiao’s sketch tracks three tools moving around a fixed load. It offers a pattern for Orbiting Blades. The loan can be closed without learning a new combat move.
story.sq05.s3.lan: Three moving supports, one quiet center. Qiao says a sword formation can use the same rhythm. He also says not to practice it near his tools.
story.sq05.s3.apprentice: I have recorded the repair, not just “returned.” Someone checking the crate next season will know where to look.
story.sq05.s3.record: Loan closure: old wheel brace freed only after stone wedge took the axle load; brace refitted at the selected site; crate contents and public placement record reconciled. Qiao’s balance sketch copied with his written permission: “Use it if it helps. Keep the arrows; they matter more than my name.”
story.sq05.s3.confirm: File the placement record and unlock Orbiting Blades training.
story.sq05.s3.retry: The brace still bears weight or its new site is unrecorded. Seat the wedge and inspect the selected fitting before closing the loan.
story.sq05.s3.done: Loan reconciled. Orbiting Blades is available for training; no duplicate reward is granted if you already know it.
story.sq05.epilogue.open: The placement record survives the first season of reopened flow. Repairs around the temporary regulator now begin with an inspection of what each “borrowed” part still supports.
story.sq05.epilogue.seal: Qiao moves the safe wedge and the placement ledger to the alternative channel. The selected fitting is reused or recorded in storage, rather than quietly written off as lost.
story.sq05.epilogue.shared: The shared maintenance rota asks for a part’s location and load before asking who owes it. Qiao adds a new column to the loan book: “Still serving.”
